# Authority Requirements Checklist: Authoritative Logo Source Contract

**Purpose**: Review whether S016 requirements completely and unambiguously protect approved logo authority and derivative lineage
**Created**: 2026-09-07
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Authority Boundaries

- [ ] CHK001 Are constructed and authoritative modes mutually exclusive, explicit, and fail-closed when missing or contradictory? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001 through §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK002 Are Full and Reduced bindings independently defined with exact role, approval-state, identifier, and hash requirements? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002 through §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK003 Does the specification prohibit every silent substitute path, including inferred sources, constructed geometry, reference artwork, and construction helpers? [Coverage, Spec §FR-004 through §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK004 Is new owner approval clearly required before geometry, character, or variant identity can change? [Gap, Spec §FR-007, §FR-020]

## Derivative Integrity

- [ ] CHK005 Is the transformation vocabulary closed and are approval requirements defined for unchanged embedding, recoloring, resizing, and lockup placement? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008 through §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK006 Are provenance fields, uniqueness, determinism, and source-to-output correspondence measurable for every mark and lockup? [Measurability, Spec §FR-010 through §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK007 Is silhouette preservation defined for raster derivatives after proportional scaling and placement, including an objective tolerance? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012, §FR-014, §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK008 Are passive SVG and unchanged-embedding requirements separated from raster-mask measurement without weakening either source type? [Consistency, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK009 Are downstream guideline, favicon, and platform-suite lineage requirements explicit enough to prevent independent reconstruction? [Coverage, Spec §FR-015]

## Failure and Migration Coverage

- [ ] CHK010 Are failure messages required to identify the affected authority rule, variant or derivative, and source when available? [Clarity, Spec §FR-017]
- [ ] CHK011 Are all seven issue regression classes explicitly required, including successful lockup and recolor paths as well as each rejection path? [Traceability, Spec §FR-018, §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK012 Is backward compatibility bounded to constructed brands without allowing legacy omission of the new source mode? [Consistency, Spec §US3, §FR-001, §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK013 Are migration invariants measurable for both path strings and supplied source bytes? [Measurability, Spec §FR-007, §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK014 Are generated-artifact boundaries, aggregate verification gates, and the no-identity-change constraint stated together? [Completeness, Spec §FR-019, §FR-020, §SC-006]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- `$speckit-implement` reads checklist state but does not modify markers.
